extraction.notes: EQR reports no AFFO; the company's adjusted FFO is 'Normalized FFO', so affo fields are null. The FFO subtotal used is 'FFO available to Common Shares and Units' (363,407), which is after preferred distributions (773) and reproduces diluted FFO/share of $0.93; the company's pre-preferred 'FFO' line is 364,180. Preferred distributions were placed in ffo_adjustments because they sit between net income and the FFO subtotal; category 'other'. Net (gain) loss on sales of real estate for Q2 2023 is 87 (loss). Normalized FFO per share diluted of $0.94 reproduces with 391,187 diluted shares/units. 'Non-operating asset (gains) losses' (317) is ambiguous in nature and was classed as 'other'. Recurring capex is only disclosed on a six-month basis (135,247 YTD), no quarterly figure found; the disclosed amount is the sum of building improvements, renovations and replacements, and includes renovation spend.
